Outcome_variable.evidence_source: In a recent study Garcia (2011a) used both the Big Five and Cloninger's model to investigate adolescents' SWB. The results showed that Self-Directedness was strongly positively related to SWB, overruling Extraversion's and even Neuroticism's influence on well-being. Garcia (2011a) concluded that the psychobiological model presented a new approach to well-being research that needs to be accounted for. Although Garcia's study might support the assumption of character (especially Self-Directedness), as an important factor in adolescents' SWB, Garcia's study was cross-sectional. In contrast, the present study investigates the influence of character on adolescents' SWB at two different points in time (i.e., Time 1, T1; Time 2, T2).
Outcome_variable.warning: The specific measure for SWB is not mentioned, so 'life satisfaction' is inferred as the most general component of 'SWB' and 'well-being'.
